editorial.title: Pecatu
content: Located in Pecatu, The Edge Bali is near theme parks and on the waterfront. Beachwalk Shopping Center and Eat Street are worth checking out if shopping is on the agenda, while those wishing to experience the area's natural beauty can explore Padang Padang Beach and Bingin Beach. Traveling with kids? Consider Waterbom Bali and Paintball Bali Jimbaran Hill Activity Village. Discover the area's water adventures with snorkeling, parasailing, and windsurfing nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with hiking/biking trails.

content.text: When you stay at The Edge Bali, you'll be within a 10-minute drive of Uluwatu Temple and Uluwatu Cliffs. Guests can visit the spa to be pampered with deep-tissue massages, body wraps, or facials, and The Cliff Bar, one of 3 restaurants, serves international cuisine and is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Other highlights at this luxurious hotel include 2 outdoor pools, a poolside bar, and a fitness center.
• Airport shuttle service is offered for an extra charge of IDR 363000 per vehicle (one-way, maximum occupancy 3)

In accordance with local regulations, all visitors must remain within the property during Seclusion Day (Nyepi)/Hindu New Year for a 24-hour period (starting at 6 AM). Seclusion Day typically falls in March or April (dates subject to change each year). Check-in and check-out will not be possible on that date. Ngurah Rai Airport (Bali International Airport) is also closed on Seclusion Day.

• Supervised childcare is available for an extra charge
  • Babysitting is available for an extra charge
  • Rollaway beds are available for IDR 1500000.0 per day
  • Airport shuttle service for children up to age 10 costs IDR 181500 (one-way)

• Children under 6 years old are not allowed in the swimming pool or fitness facility without adult supervision
  • Guests under 8 years old are not allowed in the spa
  • Reservations are required for massage services and spa treatments and can be made by contacting the property before arrival at the number on the booking confirmation
